title: Tidier screen corners
changes: The war plaque and war news now sit at the top left of the screen, above your group frame, so they no longer hide behind the monster bar.
The Gloam Tide meter is now a card in the top-right column, right above your quests.
A small chat button next to the chat box hides or shows the chat log. It remembers your choice and counts new messages while hidden.
